verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is CodeRabbit's own Triage Slack integration, which delivers the PR queue as a "scheduled digest." That is a narrow recurring delivery, not general scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows. Reviews, auto-review settings, Deep Scan and agentic finishing touches are all event- or command-triggered, with no documented cron or recurring schedule. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for reviews, scans or custom recipes; any documented schedule configuration such as cron syntax or intervals; independent corroboration.
